events.evidence: Three people are killed and seven others are injured in a mass stabbing attack in Würzburg, Bavaria, Germany
Bangladeshi authorities announces that the country will enter a total lockdown on 28 June
The United States Agency for International Development announces it estimates as many as 900,000 in the Tigray Region are facing a man-made famine

label.note: Terror attack, Tigray famine and new Bangladesh lockdown raise risk aversion; Colombia helicopter shooting adds geopolitical risk.
